intro: One glass of Milo dinosaur is about 320 kcal. The calories come from the thick layer of Milo powder on top and the condensed milk.
diet: Yes, but treat it as a dessert, not a normal drink. The calories are close to a small meal. Once in a while when you lepak with friends, that's okay. If it's every day, it can easily wipe out your calorie deficit.
tips: Share one glass with a friend.
Order Milo ais kurang manis when you want the chocolate taste without the thick topping.
If you're having Milo dinosaur, pick a lighter food like a plain roti telur with no extras.

swap.name: Milo ais kurang manis
swap.why: You still get a cold Milo, at less than half the calories.

faq.q: Why is it called Milo dinosaur?
faq.a: Because of the 'huge' pile of Milo powder on top. It became popular at mamak stalls and kopitiams.
Milo dinosaur topped with ice cream or whipped cream. Sweeter and heavier.
Yes, once in a while as a treat. For daily drinks, a regular Milo kurang manis is better.
